en.p: A point $\mathrm{P}$ starts at time $t=0$ and moves along a number line. The position $x$ of point $\mathrm{P}$ at time $t\ (t\ge 0)$ is
Which of the statements in <Statements> are correct? Choose all that apply. [4 points]

box: a. The position of point $\mathrm{P}$ at time $t=1$ is $1$.
b. The velocity of point $\mathrm{P}$ at time $t=1$ is $0$.
c. At the moment point $\mathrm{P}$ changes its direction of motion after it starts, its acceleration is $4$.
